entry.title: JPMorgan's Chang Says AI Capex Story 'Remains Intact'
entry.summary: JPMorgan Global Research Chair Joyce Chang discusses the outlook for technology stocks, explaining why she thinks the AI capex-beneficiary story "remains one that's still very much intact." entry.title: SpaceX Sells $25 Billion of Bonds, Cuts Interest Costs
entry.summary: SpaceX sold $25 billion of investment-grade bonds on Tuesday, marking the final step to replace the costly debt that had helped finance Elon Musk’s acquisition of X, then known as Twitter, as well as the expensive loans and bonds issued by xAI to bridge its rapid cash drain. Bloomberg's Manuel Baigorri reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
